name: mahainnovate
description: MahInnovate - Startup-friendly public procurement mechanism for Government of Maharashtra (Problem ID 26136)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const {execSync}=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('client')){ execSync('npm run build --prefix client', {stdio:'inherit'}); } else { execSync('npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"

author: Government of Maharashtra / MahaInnovate Team
